title: Watch Wake Up negative value preventing syncing of data when using a watch collector and coming back into range of the phone
symptom: The 'Watch Wake Up' field in the status screen counts down past zero when the watch is used as a primary collector and is out of range of the phone. This prevents the phone's xDrip from retrieving data from the watch, showing missed readings until the phone is rebooted.
cause: The failover time is reported by the watch; if they stop communicating, the time goes into the past even though at the watch end it is reset. The stall may be in the WearOS app on the phone.
fix: Force killing the WearOS app on the phone and re-opening it resolved the issue. Factory resetting the watch and installing Wear OS fresh also stopped occurrences.
evidence_quote: That did indeed fix the issue. I was able to kill the WearOS service in Tasker to accomplish the recommended fix.
